GPU timing diagnostics collect up to 300 available query results and up to 1000 CPU render samples across setup, camera settling and measurement, not exactly the PerformanceProbe interval. These are separate diagnostics, not a replacement for delivered frame cadence.
Shadow disabling, old-model/ground substitutions and context disposal are diagnostic harness operations only; they are not shipped scene changes.
The paired resource/buffer/triangle counters are retained. No reliable frame-rate benefit, loading/retained-heap comparison, exact VRAM/peak memory, real-phone or VR result is claimed.
Roof axes, widths, furniture positions and heights are visual estimates from dated aerial/Street View references, not a survey.
